mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.* FROM admin_permission p INNER JOIN admin_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN admin_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1 AND p.deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC
SELECT p.* FROM admin_permission p INNER JOIN admin_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} AND p.status = 1 AND p.deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC
